summary.text: Chris Chung is the Republican candidate for Washington's 10th Congressional District. A pharmacist from Lakewood, he ran for Washington Insurance Commissioner in 2024 and placed second in the August 2026 top-two primary for this seat. No campaign website or candidate biography beyond Ballotpedia's profile was found.

paragraphs.text: Chung lives in Lakewood, Washington. Ballotpedia, citing VoteWA, reports that he holds a graduate degree in pharmacy from St. John's University and has worked as a pharmacist.

In 2024 he ran for Washington Commissioner of Insurance as a Democrat and placed seventh in the primary with 2.9% of the vote. In his statement for the state voter guide he wrote that the commissioner has "the responsibility of safely protecting our Washington State residents."

Chung advanced from the August 4, 2026 nonpartisan primary for Washington's 10th District with 33.4% of the vote, behind incumbent Marilyn Strickland's 49.3%, and is the Republican candidate in the general election.
